# AI Edutech App — Statement of Work (SOW)

**Date:** 14 June 2026 **Project:** AI Edutech App — 9th & 10th Board Exam Preparation (MVP)

## 1\. Project Summary

**AI Edutech App** is a complete, AI-powered exam-preparation platform for **9th & 10th class** students (**Punjab Board & FBISE**). In one app it brings together **chapter-wise learning (video \+ notes), MCQs, fill-in-the-blanks, short questions, flashcards, past papers, tests, a 24/7 AI tutor, AI study plans, and progress tracking** — on **Android and Web**, with **offline mode** and **real-time sync**.

It is delivered as a **native Android app first, then a full responsive web app** (both from the same codebase and backend; iOS is a future phase), with a separate **marketing landing page**, **subscription billing in PKR** via local payment rails, and **push notifications**.

## 2\. Objectives

- Deliver the full verified flow: Onboarding → Study → Practice & Test → AI Tutor → Progress & Reports → Profile.  
- Provide an **AI layer**: 24/7 doubt solving, concept explanation, weak-area test generation, daily study plans, and smart flashcards.  
- Deliver the **native Android app first, then the web app** — one shared backend and codebase.  
- Support **subscription \+ local payments** (cards \+ JazzCash \+ EasyPaisa) at **Rs 1,000/month**.  
- Hold up under **concurrent-user load** with reliable **push notifications**, **offline mode**, and **cross-device sync**.

## 3\. Target Users

- **Students** — Class 9 & 10, Punjab Board \+ FBISE. Mobile-first, exam-focused.  
- **Parents** — view progress and shareable report cards.  
- **Content Admin** *(internal)* — ingests and manages the **client-provided** content in the web CMS.  
- **Affiliate marketing TBD**

## 4\. Core UX Principles

- **One place for everything** — learning, practice, past papers, AI help, and progress in a single app with a 6-tab bottom nav (Home · Study · Practice · AI Tutor · Progress · Profile).  
- **AI deeply integrated** — embedded in learning ("Ask AI" in lessons), practice (test generation), and progress (weak-topic analysis, study plans).  
- **Engagement-first** — daily plan, XP, scores, streaks of activity, report cards, push reminders.  
- **Mobile-first \+ offline** — works well on phones; downloaded content available offline; syncs across devices.  
- **Smooth, connected flow** — all screens connected; clean, recognisable design.  
- **Consistent across platforms** — web and mobile share one backend, logic, and data, so the experience stays identical (mobile is built first, then web).

## 5\. Platforms & Build Approach

- **Web \+ API \+ Admin:** **Next.js (App Router, TypeScript)** — the web app, the REST/tRPC API, and the content-admin/CMS.  
- **Mobile (native):** **React Native \+ Expo (EAS)** — true native **Android** from one codebase (Android only; iOS is a future phase).  
- **Shared code:** **Turborepo monorepo** (types, API client, validation, domain logic) used by both.  
- **Built sequentially** — the **native mobile app first** (standing up the shared backend \+ monorepo), then the **web app**, which reuses that backend (so it's mostly UI and goes faster).

## 6\. Functional Scope (MVP)

### 6.1 Onboarding

Splash → Welcome → **Choose Class** (9 / 10\) → **Select Board** (Punjab Board / FBISE) → **Select Subjects** (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, Urdu, Islamiat) → **Create Account** (name, email/phone, password) → **Subscription** (Premium, Rs 1,000/month) → **Dashboard**.

### 6.2 Dashboard (Home)

- "Today's Plan" with task completion (e.g. 3/8), **Continue Learning** (resume last chapter), **Quick Actions** (AI Tutor, MCQs, Test).  
- Greets the student by name.

### 6.3 Study (Learning)

- **Subjects → Chapters → Chapter Content → Lesson Content.**  
- Chapter content tabs: **Learn / Notes / Examples**; **video lessons** \+ exercises (client-provided).  
- Lesson content: key concepts \+ **"Ask AI"** (embedded AI explanation).  
- Per-chapter **progress %**.

### 6.4 Practice & Test

- **Practice Home:** MCQs (topic-wise & mixed), **Fill in the Blanks**, **Short Questions**, **Flashcards**, **Past Papers**.  
- **MCQs:** question, options, Previous/Next; **result** \= correct/incorrect \+ **explanation** \+ **XP**.  
- **Tests:** graded, score \+ % (e.g. 8/10, 80%), **Review Answers**.

### 6.5 AI Tutor (24/7)

- Entry points: **Ask a Doubt**, **Explain a Topic**, **Solve a Question**, **Concept Clarification**.  
- Step-by-step explanations with examples; **"Was this helpful?"** feedback; chat history; ask another question.

### 6.6 Progress & Reports

- **Overview:** overall progress % \+ per-subject %.  
- **Performance analytics:** accuracy, tests taken, questions solved, trend chart (by week).  
- **Weak Topics:** per subject, with %, "Study Now".  
- **Report Card:** monthly grade (e.g. A-), **shareable** (students & parents).

### 6.7 AI Features

- **AI Doubt Solver** — instant step-by-step answers.  
- **AI Concept Explainer** — complex topics in simple words.  
- **AI Test Generator** — personalized tests based on weak areas.  
- **AI Progress Analyzer** — identifies weak topics & suggests a plan.  
- **AI Study Planner** — daily study plan.  
- **AI Flashcards** — smart flashcards for revision.

### 6.8 Content Pipeline & Admin CMS (web)

- **Client provides all source content** — chapter content, video lessons, notes, MCQs, fill-in-the-blanks, short questions, past papers.  
- We **ingest and structure** it into the curriculum (board → class → subject → chapter → lesson), store text/structured data in **Postgres**, and serve **video/media via Bunny.net CDN**.  
- The **admin CMS** manages the catalogue, content, and media.

### 6.9 Authentication & Roles

- **Supabase Auth** — sign-up/login via **email or phone \+ password**.  
- **Roles:** Student; Content Admin (web CMS). *(Parent view via shared report cards.)*

### 6.10 Subscription & Payments

- **Premium — Rs 1,000/month**, PKR. **Safepay** (cards \+ JazzCash \+ EasyPaisa); entitlement gating; webhooks; payment history.  
- *Stripe is not available to Pakistan-registered businesses (see §13); Safepay is the substitute.*

### 6.11 Notifications

- **Push via FCM** (web \+ Android): study reminders, daily-plan nudges, deadline reminders.

### 6.12 Landing Page

- A **separate marketing site** (outside the app), clean/recognisable design, sign-up CTA, store links.

### 6.13 Cross-Platform, Offline & Sync

- **Android & Web** from one codebase; **offline mode** for downloaded content; **real-time sync** across devices.

### 6.14 Referrals

- Admin Management & Onboarding: Administrators log into the Matric Mate system and manually add or approve users as official referrers.  
- Automated Code & QR Generation: Once a referrer is successfully created, the system automatically generates a unique, non-editable Referral Code (e.g., `MMT7X0K2`) along with a shareable QR Code.  
- Sharing & Student Onboarding: Referrers share their unique link, code, or QR code with prospective students. When students register using these credentials, they are permanently linked to the respective referrer.  
- Performance Tracking: Referrers gain access to a dedicated analytics portal to track student onboarding, conversion statuses, and earned commissions.

#### Referral Dashboard Features (Real-Time Analytics)

The system will provide a comprehensive, real-time dashboard UI displaying the following key metrics and data visualizations:

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):  
  * Total Students Joined: Total number of student sign-ups attributed to the referrer.  
  * Paid Students: Number of referred students with active, paid subscriptions.  
  * Pending Students: Registered students who have not yet converted to a paid tier.  
  * Active Students: Total number of currently active learners.  
* Data Visualizations & Reports:  
  * Joins Overview: A line/trend graph showing historical student registration velocity over time (filterable by weeks/months).  
  * Conversion Breakdown: A visual donut chart mapping the distribution of Paid vs. Pending students.  
  * Conversion Rate Indicator: A radial progress bar showing the live percentage of referred users who successfully converted to a paid subscription.  
* Financial Tracking:  
  * Total Earnings Hub: Real-time display of accumulated commissions/payouts (denominated locally, e.g., PKR).  
  * Activity Logs: A chronological list or ledger tracking recent registrations, subscription status updates, and corresponding commission milestones.

## 7\. Tech Stack

| Component | Choice | Reason |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Web \+ API \+ Admin | Next.js (App Router, TS) | Web app \+ API \+ CMS in one deployable |
| Mobile (Android) | React Native \+ Expo (EAS) | True native, cross-platform, shares code with web |
| Shared code | Turborepo monorepo | Types / API client / validation / domain logic shared |
| Database \+ Auth \+ Storage | Supabase (Postgres) | Postgres \+ Auth \+ Storage \+ RLS |
| AI tutor (runtime) | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Doubt solving, explanations, solve-a-question |
| AI test generation / flashcards / study plan | Claude Haiku 4.5 | Cheap, high-volume generation |
| Video \+ media delivery | Bunny.net (Stream \+ CDN) | Cheap, offloads heavy video bandwidth **No video for now..** |
| Payments | Safepay (cards \+ JazzCash \+ EasyPaisa) | PK-registered businesses can onboard |
| Push notifications | Firebase Cloud Messaging | Free, web \+ Android |
| CDN / WAF | Cloudflare | Caching, TLS, DDoS protection |
| Hosting (origin) | Vercel (launch) → VPS (Hetzner) at scale | Ship fast, migrate for cost later |
| Analytics | In-house event tracking → Postgres | Powers progress, weak topics, report cards |
| Audio TTS *(optional)* | Azure Neural TTS (ur-PK \+ English) | Only if voice-over is confirmed (see §13) |

## 8\. Data Model Overview (Indicative)

| Group | Key Tables |
| :---- | :---- |
| Core | users, roles, user\_roles |
| Curriculum | boards (Punjab, FBISE), classes (9, 10), subjects, chapters, lessons |
| Content | lesson\_content (video/notes/examples), mcqs, fill\_blanks, short\_questions, flashcards, past\_papers |
| Practice & Progress | attempts, test\_attempts, xp\_events, chapter\_progress, subject\_progress, weak\_topics, report\_cards |
| AI | ai\_chat\_sessions, generated\_tests, study\_plans, ai\_usage\_quota |
| Subscriptions | subscriptions, payments, entitlements |
| Media | media\_files (Bunny references — video, images) |
| Admin / Content Ops | content\_imports, content\_review |

**Design principles:**

- Curriculum is **metadata-driven** (board / class / subject / chapter / lesson) — adding boards or classes is configuration, not code.  
- **Client-provided content** is ingested and kept separate from user/attempt data.  
- Every meaningful study action emits an **event** (drives progress, weak topics, report cards).  
- Structured storage for attempts and answers — analytics- and AI-ready.

## 10\. Timeline & Phases

**\~11 weeks total (18 Jul → 30 Sep 2026, per the signed Upwork milestones)**, AI-assisted, delivered in **two sequential stages**: the **native Android app first** (M1–M5, → 29 Aug, incl. Play Store launch — this stage also stands up the shared backend) and then the **web app** (M6–M10, → 30 Sep — landing page, admin CMS, web UI, web go-live; reuses the same backend). Content is supplied by the client in parallel. Full phase breakdown in `AI Edutech App — Technical Feasibility & Architecture.md` §6; the **payment milestones** are in §15 below.

## 11\. Performance & Infrastructure

- **Concurrency** met by **offloading**: video/media via Bunny CDN, static/API caching via Cloudflare, DB connection pooling — the origin only does light JSON work.  
- **AI endpoints** carry **per-user quotas** \+ caching to bound cost/load.  
- **Video bandwidth** is the main cost that scales with usage — cheap on Bunny (\~Rs 1.4/GB).  
- **Indicative run-cost** (launch): **≈ Rs 33,000–90,000/mo** \+ \~2–3% payment processing. Full breakdown in `AI Edutech App — Technical Feasibility & Architecture.md` §4.

## 12\. Out of Scope

- Mind-map; per-question confidence slider (not in the verified flow).  
- AI writing/owning core content (client provides all content; AI augments).  
- Community / leaderboard.  
- Stripe via a PK entity (using Safepay instead).

## 13\. Constraints & Assumptions

1. **Client provides all source content** (chapters, videos, notes, MCQs, past papers) — content is **not** a build bottleneck; we ingest and structure it.  
2. **Stripe is unavailable to Pakistan-registered businesses** — card acceptance uses a local PSP (Safepay), unless a UK/US entity is used.  
3. **Video bandwidth** is the main usage-scaling cost — kept cheap via Bunny CDN.  
4. **Web and native apps share logic, not UI** — both TypeScript on one monorepo, but React Native renders native components, so screens are built once per platform (budgeted in §10).  
5. **Testing/QA is included** in each phase (web: Playwright \+ unit; mobile: Jest \+ RN Testing Library \+ device E2E).  
6. **Audio voice-over (TTS)** is **optional** — only built if confirmed (Azure `ur-PK` Urdu \+ English); see Scope doc open questions.

| \# | Milestone | Due | Amount | Deliverable (reviewed on a staging link) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| M6 | Foundation \+ **live landing page** \+ onboarding \+ auth (web) | 5 Sep | **US$178** | First web milestone — live landing page with sign-up \+ web app foundation |
| M7 | Curriculum \+ admin CMS \+ Study (video / notes / "Ask AI") | 12 Sep | US$85 | Browse subjects → chapters → lessons; client content loaded |

**Payment terms (protect both sides):**

- The **first milestone of each stage is an advance**, paid before that stage's work starts.  
- **Pay-to-proceed** — each milestone is funded before its work begins (on acceptance of the prior one).  
- **Deemed accepted in 3–5 business days** if no feedback is given — the milestone is then payable.  
- **2 feedback/revision rounds** per milestone included; extra rounds are billed.  
- **Go-live, source handover, and Play Store publish happen only after the relevant final milestone is paid.** Web (Stage B) may start before Mobile (Stage A) is fully paid.
